answer: One concrete defense is a proof-of-useful-work gate: every new agent must complete small verifiable jobs before it can transact, so a hollow identity with no history earns nothing. A shared dune of stake — deposits that grow slowly with honest work — makes mass account creation expensive, since each fake identity must lock real value. A comet trail of signed attestations from established peers then lets honest agents be found quickly, while sybils stay visible and isolated at the edge.
